nodes.name: HTTP - BGG Collection
nodes.notes: BGG sometimes returns HTTP 202 with a <message> body while it builds the export. This workflow checks for that below and asks the user to retry rather than looping indefinitely.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'pending', message: 'BGG is still preparing your collection export. Wait about 10 seconds and click Sync from BGG again.' } }}

nodes.name: Data Table - Upsert Each Game
nodes.notes: After import: pick your Data Table, operation 'Upsert Row', match column game_id. This node runs once per incoming item automatically.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { added: 0, updated: items.length, total: items.length, note: 'Added/updated split not tracked in this simplified workflow \u2014 total reflects rows upserted this sync.' } }];
